text: Trend-line gate (F06 §4): the current rule — ≥3 daily scalars within [today-6, today] — keeps the line hidden forever after any ≥2-week lapse and blocks back-filled history (WLO-0053 §D). Re-scope it?
suggestions: Re-scope: render the line when the selected window holds ≥3 daily scalars (recommended — warm-up copy only for genuinely new users)
Re-scope with a span floor: ≥3 scalars spanning ≥5 days in-window (stops a 3-day burst drawing a line)
Keep the today-anchored gate; fix the copy only (lapsed users get dots + honest message, never a line)

text: The chart's top-right 'latest' numeral silently falls back to the window max when the trend line is hidden — the '78.3 / 78.3' duplicate in the screenshots (WLO-0053 §B). Treatment?
suggestions: Drop the numeral from the canvas: high/low only on the chart, 'latest' stays the hero card's job (recommended)
Keep it, but bind it to the latest daily scalar when the trend is hidden, with a tiny 'latest' tag so its meaning is explicit

## Acceptance criteria

- 30 d / 90 d / 1 y produce visibly different charts for the same data.
- A window with no rows shows the in-chart message + jump action, never a
  160 dp void; the tuner is hidden there.
- The same number never renders in two labels; "latest" only ever renders
  from a real value.
- Lapsed/back-filled history shows the trend line (per the gate ruling) or
  the lapsed copy — never the warm-up line to someone who already has data.
- Axis numerals match their gridline values (rounded, not floored).
- Caption reads the window range; data extent + year appended per rules.
- The reference line never renders without the trend line.
- TalkBack announces window, point count, range, and the state copy.
text:
Implementation evidence (2026-09-16):

- `WloTrendChart` now receives an explicit selected-window domain, renders sparse time ticks and a window-framed caption with stale data extent, rounds high/low outward to sane steps, and deliberately has no latest corner label/fallback.
- F06 state gates trend and reference identically at >=3 daily scalars in the selected window; warm-up, lapsed, and empty copy are distinct. Empty windows probe only progressively wider bounded repository windows, expose the smallest window with data, and hide the tuner.
- F06 §4 was amended to the approved selected-window ruling. Canvas semantics now include window, point count, high/low/latest, and the state.
- Deterministic PASS: `TrendChartGeometryTest` (5 tests) and `WeighInViewModelReliabilityTest` (13 tests), including lapsed >7-day history, <3 held trend/reference, wider-window action, x fractions, ticks, nice bounds, high/low-only labels, captions/year/stale suffix.
- Focused device PASS three times: `M3WeighInTest#emptyThirtyDayWindow_offersSmallestWiderWindow_andHidesTuner`. It verifies D30 empty copy/action/tuner-hidden, widens to D90, verifies lapsed copy/tuner-restored and the full a11y summary. Final visual evidence is attached as `wlo0053-empty-window-final.png` and `wlo0053-lapsed-window-final.png`.
- PASS: Android-test compile; app Android-test ktlint; design-system + F06 ktlint and detekt; F06 lint; `checkArchitecture`; `git diff --check`.
- Known unrelated gate: design-system `lintDebug` remains red at pre-existing `WloHaptics.kt:121` for `MissingPermission(VIBRATE)`. No WLO-0053 file is implicated; F06 lint is green.
